source: STEER Project (Save the Children, iDE Cambodia, and the Cambodian Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries) - "Guide on Banana Cultivation Techniques" (សៀវភៅណែនាំស្តីអំពី បច្ចេកទេសដាំដុះដំណាំចេក), February 2020
text:
Chek Ambong (ចេកអំបូង) is a large-fruited banana variety producing elongated fruit in substantial bunches. It is a long-standing, well-recognized Cambodian variety, grown from corm cuttings like other local types, and valued by farmers for good bunch weight.

Ambong was also used as one of the three Cambodian local-check varieties in the Prek Leap National School of Agriculture's banana variety trial, where local varieties were compared against a set of internationally sourced accessions for vegetative growth, flowering time, and yield.
